action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 2-dimensional")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")
    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Compute weighted losses
    loss_with_result = -np.dot(logp_with_result, normalized_weights)
    loss_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, normalized_weights)
    loss_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, normalized_weights)

    # Baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Margin and keep
    margin = L_minus - loss_with_result
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
